    Presentations of split basic algebras by quivers #

    Gabriel's presentation in the form needed for the data of Theorem 3.10: a finite-dimensional split basic algebra B with idempotents e_x is a quotient of a path algebra kQ. The vertices of Q are the x, the arrows x → y are lifts to e_y J e_x of a basis of the corner e_y (J/J²) e_x of the first radical layer, and π : kQ → B sends e_x ↦ e_x and each arrow to its lift (SplitBasicData.presentation). It is surjective by the nilpotent generation criterion (NilGen.surjective_of_nilpotent_ideal).
